author: Bellular News
description:
Marvel Rivals was just the start of an incredible year for NetEase. But behind that success, something else was happening — and it left veteran developers from BioWare, Bethesda, and 343 with nothing. One man made a decision. Half a dozen studios paid for it.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
